$comment: Renders this catalog knowingly publishes as byte-identical siblings, and why.
A component's variant cells exist to show something the default does not. When two
of them hash the same, the sheet is publishing one picture under two names: it
claims coverage it does not have, and any parity number computed for the second
cell is scoring the first cell's picture. That is a defect wherever it appears,
so scripts/duplicate-renders.mjs fails the render on any collision that is not
A declaration is not a fix. Each entry below names an open issue: the cell is a
real comparison the kit publishes and the render cannot yet make. Keeping the
list here rather than in a wiki page means the count is maintained by the build —
and the check fails in BOTH directions, so a set that stops colliding (because
someone fixed it) fails until its entry is deleted.
`function` is the sticker's Kotlin function name, `collisions` the variant names
whose renders may coincide. `default` is the unseeded base render. A theme is not
named: the check groups renders per (preview, theme, capture), so one entry covers
the light and dark copies of the same collision.

declarations.reason: Button/Text draws no container, so `shape=square` has nothing to reshape and every square cell repeats its round sibling. The cells stay authored: the kit publishes both shapes for this style, so the pair is a real comparison the render cannot yet make.
IconButton/Standard draws no container either — same cause as Button/Text, three times the cells because the width axis crosses the size one.
